criteria.criterion: PLAN.md §2 layout exists with real (not empty-stub) core: loop (realtime+manual clock), events, rng, tuning registry, store with versioning, flags, debugApi implementing every §4 method
criteria.evidence: All src/core files are real: loop 138 lines (integer-microsecond 120 Hz fixed step), rng mulberry32, tuning registry with 157 live paths, store with version, migrations and deep-fill, flags, debugApi. Every §4 method checked live. realtime advanced 43 frames in 600 ms; manual stayed frozen. step(10) gave 10 frames / 20 ticks and step(3,30) gave 12 ticks. setSeed(4242) was applied to the next run. Same seed gave identical entities; a different seed differed. startRun({scenario,seed,skipIntro}) worked. goto() reached all 8 screens with the matching DOM visible. input() accepted all 7 actions and left/right/jump/roll/pause took effect. getState had every §4 field. setTuning/getTuning round-tripped; an unknown path returned false. cheat('setSpeed',21) gave speed 21; an unknown cheat threw. §8b module augmentation is used in 6 owning modules. criteria.criterion: A playable greybox run: 3 lanes, forward motion, left/right/jump/roll via keyboard and touch swipe, one obstacle type, coins, crash ends run, restart works
criteria.evidence: Contact sheets show 3 lanes, forward motion, a jump arc, an airborne lane change, slam into roll (ball) and roll-jump cancel. Real keyboard: ArrowLeft→lane -1, KeyD→lane 0, Space→y 0.55, Shift→roll. Real CDP touch swipes: left -1, right 0, up y 0.98, down roll. touch-rapid gave 7 flicks, exactly 1 action each, motion after 0 frames. Two obstacle types (barrierLow, train). coin-line collected 10 coins; god-mode run collected 42. barrier-ahead crashed at 2.93 s → gameover at 4.03 s. Unaided realtime run crashed by 102 m. Restart worked by real mouse click on Play again, keyboard Enter, and touch tap on Play again. Tap-to-start on home passed 60/60 fresh-page CDP trials.

criteria.criterion: public/assets/manifest.json + placeholder fallback: deleting/renaming any src never breaks the game; swapping one texture file changes the render with zero code edits
criteria.evidence: Served a copy of dist with Workers-style SPA fallback. Dropped a magenta/yellow 256² PNG at textures/track/yard_ground.png. assets().loaded gained tex.ground.yard, 129/5184 downscaled pixels changed, and the ground visibly became checker (screenshots compared). Then: renaming that src in track.json, renaming the file on disk, prefixing every src in all 4 parts with nope/, deleting the ui.json part, and garbage bytes at png/glb/svg/ogg srcs each still reached screen=run with distance > 0 and zero page errors.

biggest_gap: The name 'Subway Surfers' is in 5 committed lines, and the criterion says 'anywhere in the repo'. gauntlet/board.html:114 is visible text on the progress page. PLAN.md:5,134,138 and gauntlet/pieces.json:19 carry it too, and it is in the history of commits 8a6b778 and 9c55a01. Fix: replace every occurrence with a neutral term (e.g. 'the reference game') in all tracked files. PLAN.md and pieces.json are the orchestrator's binding contracts, so the orchestrator must approve those edits. Scrubbing history needs a rewrite, which the orchestrator must also decide.
